preregistration.name: HD 19994 b Milestone 26 held-out detector-v0.5 validation
preregistration.scientific_target: An intermittent narrowband signal coherent under the selected HD 19994 b motion hypothesis; the signal is not assumed to originate on the planet or to be aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Advance HD 19994 at frozen discovery rank 22 after rank 21 completed in Milestone 25; search the sole complete compatible L-band cadence --84358 after all metadata and full-bank coverage checks pass.
preregistration.survey_scope: One complete GBT L-band alternating ON/OFF cadence, five frozen 1 MHz planet-frame windows, and detector v0.5.0. There is no second qualifying HD 19994 L-band cadence, so this milestone cannot establish independent recurrence. Telescope, bands, recurrence statistic, thresholds, spectral widths, orbital scale/phase bank, RFI mask, detector-v0.5 vetoes, empirical calibration, completeness procedure, and complete cluster retention remain frozen. The 1200-cluster report cap exceeds the finite maximum of 1008 pre-clustering peaks per window and cannot truncate a complete disposition record.

completeness.method: Real m26_1412p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 5 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
The strong-single-epoch RFI mask and recurrence statistic were added after the first Milestone 7 diagnostic run; independent future bands are required for confirmation.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
